caption:
The video captures a night scene viewed through a glass pane streaked with running water and scattered small droplets. Against the black background, a roughly horizontal row of out-of-focus coloured lights forms soft bokeh circles in red, amber, white and bright green. The dark backdrop and the row remain visible throughout, while the water on the pane keeps flowing, merging and reshaping in front of them, constantly changing their outlines.

Thin vertical rivulets and droplets continuously appear, merge and slide downward, warping the lights where they cross. Distortion sometimes turns a circle into a ring-like shape, though many circles stay solid. The fixed coloured dots hold their horizontal positions but cycle in hue, an amber light turning red and a red light later flashing back to yellow.

Meanwhile the two white bokeh blobs drift steadily leftward across the frame, sliding past the otherwise fixed coloured dots until they move out of view. The remaining coloured lights continue to glow and shift behind the running water.
relations: Vertical rivulets and droplets slide downward across the pane, warping the bokeh circles they cross.
The two white blobs drift steadily leftward, sliding past the otherwise fixed coloured dots.
Coloured dots hold horizontal positions while cycling hue, amber turning red and red flashing back to yellow.
The dark backdrop and horizontal row persist as water merges and reshapes, constantly changing outlines.
